name: MLQA
description: Multilingual Question Answering (MLQA) is a cross-lingual extractive QA benchmark covering 7 languages. Contexts and questions are aligned across languages, enabling evaluation of both machine translation quality and cross-lingual transfer. Built from Wikipedia articles with parallel contexts across languages.
reputation: Standard multilingual extractive QA benchmark; published at ACL 2020; widely used to evaluate multilingual reading comprehension in mBERT, XLM-R, and similar models
notes: Introduced at ACL 2020. Covers English, Arabic, German, Spanish, Hindi, Vietnamese, and Chinese. Cross-lingual evaluation: model is tested on contexts/questions in different languages than training. 46,406 QA instances total across 7 languages. Note: mega_mlqa.json exists but MLQA (base) is separate. Standard component for evaluating multilingual NLU.
